summary: PMA Graphene Technology Group Inc., a Hong Kong-domiciled foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K supplying the Rule 3-05 audited financials of Meals Through Seasons Limited and Article 11 pro forma combined information tied to its previously closed acquisition of the entire issued share capital of the target. The acquisition closed September 2, 2026, per the referenced Closing 6-K; no price, premium, stake other than 100%, or advisor is stated here. The target was incorporated December 4, 2025, so its audit period is under one year. Watch integration, pro forma dilution and any earn-out or consideration disclosures in the original agreement exhibits.
